AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING.description: The request does not include a valid JWT token in the jwt_token parameter

AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.description: The provided JWT token is malformed, has invalid signature, or cannot be decoded

AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED.description: The provided JWT token has exceeded its valid time period

AUTH_USER_NOT_FOUND.message: User not found for provided authentication token
AUTH_USER_NOT_FOUND.description: The JWT token references a user that does not exist in the database
AUTH_USER_NOT_FOUND.user_action: Ensure user account exists and is active
